commits.subject: Allow hosts to route selected analytics events (#62684)
commits.reason: Keep the optional upstream host transport and the existing ALab analytics opt-out. A host can select an event type explicitly when analytics is enabled.
evidence: b059ce11f9:codex-rs/analytics/src/client.rs installs the transport in a new opt-in constructor. The queue filters by destination and existing auth eligibility before dispatch. Rebinding to another auth context drops the previous transport.

b059ce11f9:codex-rs/analytics/src/event_transport.rs sends a selected event with its complete wire payload and product SKU. An unselected event, a serialization failure or an explicit Http response preserves ordinary HTTP delivery. Handled transfers responsibility to the host and suppresses the duplicate HTTP send. A host that installs this API owns its delivery deadline.
codex-rs/alab-core/defaults.toml keeps product analytics disabled. This upstream change adds the optional constructor without adding a caller in the ALab host or changing the packaged setting.

All four native transport tests passed on pristine b059ce11f9 with the locked graph and source-selected Trust 15698 on macOS arm64. They exercised mixed-batch HTTP payloads and product attribution, API-key eligibility, local capture, analytics opt-out and rebinding to a different actor.
